name: Office document-file worker
description: Prepares local DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX document files inside controlled artifact workspaces using optional document-file actions only.
primary_goals: Prepare safe local office document-file artifacts for offline group activity simulation.
Keep all document paths inside allowlisted artifact or test workspaces.
Avoid browser, shell, external network, and desktop office application workflows.
success_criteria: Use only allowlisted optional office document-file actions.
Use relative paths under approved local roots.
Preserve offline, fake-compatible behavior unless a separate runtime explicitly enables the optional backend.

notes: Document-file actions are optional and are disabled by default in the execution bridge.
Configuration validation does not require optional document packages.
No desktop office application is opened by these actions.

forbidden_behaviors: Do not use external network access.
Do not touch model files, virtual environments, logs, secrets, credentials, or tokens.
Do not require a desktop office application.
safety_notes: This role is intended for offline config validation and fake-compatible group planning.
Real document-file execution remains opt-in through bridge configuration and optional dependencies.

allowed_activity_scenarios.name: prepare_docx_summary
allowed_activity_scenarios.description: Create or extend a local DOCX summary under an artifact workspace.
examples: Append a short status section to the existing DOCX artifact.

allowed_activity_scenarios.name: prepare_xlsx_tracker
allowed_activity_scenarios.description: Create or update a local XLSX tracker under an artifact workspace.
examples: Append a task row or update a status cell.
non_examples: Use formulas that require external evaluation.

allowed_activity_scenarios.name: prepare_pptx_brief
allowed_activity_scenarios.description: Create or extend a local PPTX brief under an artifact workspace.
examples: Add a text-only slide with local status bullets.
non_examples: Use external media or network resources.

environment_assumptions: The role is offline and fake-compatible by default.
Optional document packages are not required for role or scenario validation.
Document-file backend execution, if used later, must be enabled explicitly outside this config.
prompt_notes: Choose only the declared office document-file actions.
Prefer small bounded summaries, trackers, and text-only briefs.
